data.name: Muhtady
data.gender_notes: Muhtady is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has acquired knowledge, a scholar. The name Muhtady carries the meaning “Learned” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Muhtady usually hope their child will grow to embody learned and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Muhtady belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Learned.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhtady total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: مُهتَدى
in_arabic.meaning: مُهتَدى: مُهتَدىً لِلّهَ، مَن يَهتَدي بِهِ اللَّهُ
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُهتَدى: اسم فاعل من هَدى، مَن يُهتَدى به في الطَريقِ الصَوابِ، ويُستَعان به في الخَلقِ، و هو مَن يَهتَدي بِهِ اللَّهُ إِلَى الصِّدقِ و الإِيمَانِ وَطِيبِ الأَعْمَالِ، كَما أَنَّهُ مَن يَدعو إِلى هُدًى وَيَقودُ الناسَ إِلَى رِشَادِهم، فَتُسَمَّى مُهتَدىً لِلّهَ، وَهُوَ مِنَ الأَسْمَاءِ الحُسنى الَّتِي تَدلُ عَلَى هُدًى اللَّهِ لِخَلقِهِ

in_urdu.name: مہتدی
in_urdu.meaning: مہتدی: جو اللہ کی راہ پر چلتا ہے، راستہ دکھانے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مہتدی: مہتدی وہ شخص ہے جو اللہ کی راہ پر چلتا ہے اور دوسروں کو بھی صحیح راستے پر لانے کی کوشش کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام اللہ کے ایسی صفت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو اپنے بندوں کو ہدایت فراہم کرتا ہے۔ مہتدی کا مطلب ہے کہ جو شخص اللہ کی ہدایت کو قبول کرتا ہے اور اس کے مطابق زندگی گزارتا ہے، اسی طرح یہ نام اسلامی تقویم اور ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: मुहतदी
in_hindi.meaning: मुहतदी: जो अल्लाह की राह पर चलता है, सच्चाई की तलाश करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुहतदी: यह नाम उन विशेषताओं को प्रकट करता है जो व्यक्ति को सही रास्ते पर ले जाने में मदद करते हैं। मुहतदी का अर्थ है कि जो व्यक्ति अल्लाह की हिदायत को स्वीकार करता है और उसके अनुसार जीवन व्यतीत करता है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है और उन लोगों के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है जो सच्चाई और आत्म-ज्ञान की खोज में लगे रहते हैं

in_pashto.name: مُهْتَدى
in_pashto.meaning: مُهْتَدى: هغه څوک چې د الله په لاره روان دي، لارښود
in_pashto.long_meaning: مُهْتَدى: دا نوم د الله د لارښوونې د منلو او د هغه د مرضياتو د ترلاسه کولو لپاره کارول کېږي. مُهْتَدى هغه څوک دی چې د الله په لاره روان دي او د نورو د لارښوونې لپاره يې هڅوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتني کلتورونو د ارزښتونو او دودونو څخه دي

in_english.name: Muhtady
in_english.meaning: Muhtady: Guided by Allah, one who follows the right path
in_english.long_meaning: Muhtady: This name signifies one who is guided by Allah and follows the right path. It is derived from the Arabic root 'hada' which means 'to guide'. In Islamic tradition, Muhtady refers to a person who is led by divine guidance and walks on the path of righteousness. The name holds significant spiritual meaning and is often chosen for its positive connotations of guidance and wisdom. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote a person who is on the right path as guided by Allah

data.cultural_impact: The name "Muhtady" holds a great deal of cultural significance for the Muslim community, as it symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. In Islamic tradition, acquiring knowledge and education are highly valued, and scholars hold a respected and honored place in society. The title "Muhtady" is a reminder of this cultural emphasis on learning and intellectual growth. It is a noble title that represents dedication, discipline, and intellectual curiosity.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Muhtady" holds a deeper meaning. It is a reflection of the Islamic belief that knowledge is a means to draw closer to God. The pursuit of knowledge and wisdom is seen as a way to gain a better understanding of the divine, to deepen one's faith, and to live a more virtuous life. The title "Muhtady" is a reminder of this spiritual connection between learning and God, and it serves as a source of inspiration for those who bear the name to continue on their spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Learned" symbolizes One who has acquired knowledge, a scholar. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Muhtady serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of learned.
